notes.title: Update notes
notes.notes:
Thanks for playing Pokerist! We've been improving the game with every release.
In this version, we've added a variety of minor updates and enhanced the overall experience.

• NOW AVAILABLE ON macOS •
You can now enjoy Pokerist on macOS as well! Download the game and join the action on your favorite platform.

• NEW SLOT •
Conquer the element of fire! Hot winnings await in the new Flaming Flux slot!

• NEW JACKPOT •
Want to find out what reward is hidden inside? Hit the jackpot in the Hack the Safe slot!

• NEW EVENTS •
Don't miss out on exciting quests and a unique pass!

We hope you have a great time in our game!

notes.title: Update for Texas Hold’em Poker: Pokerist!
notes.notes:
We’re always working to make the game even better! This update brings general improvements, optimizations, and refinements to enhance your experience.

Stay tuned for more exciting updates in the future, and thank you for playing!

notes.title: 🎮 Important update on Pokerist Steam release
notes.notes:
Dear community, 

We need to inform you that the release of Pokerist on Steam has been delayed due to some technical challenges. Our development team works around the clock to ensure we deliver the high-quality gaming experience you deserve. 

While we can't provide an exact release date, we want to assure you that resolving these issues is our top priority. 

We understand this news may disappoint many of you, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience. We'll share the new release date as soon as possible!

Thank you for your patience and continued support. Stay tuned for updates!

                                                                                                                   The KamaGames Team
